[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-editor"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Canvas-agnostic editor state machine (selection, transforms, undo) for the framework"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "editor"

[lints]
workspace = true

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.dev]
wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

# 🪶️ REDUCE-DEMONSTRATOR-IDLE-MEMORY-FOOTPRINT. Applies when 📜️script.ts builds with wasm-pack
# `--profile wasm-release` (wasm-pack 0.15+ maps any custom profile name to this `custom` section,
# ignoring `profile.release` above). Runs after wasm-bindgen, mirroring os-dev's plugin -Oz post-pass
# (WASM_OPT_ARGS) minus `--low-memory-unused`: this module's stack-first memory layout means the
# "low 1KB is unused" assumption binaryen makes for that flag is unverified here.
[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.custom]
wasm-opt = ["-Oz", "--strip-debug", "--strip-producers", "--enable-bulk-memory", "--enable-bulk-memory-opt", "--enable-call-indirect-overlong", "--enable-extended-const", "--enable-multivalue", "--enable-mutable-globals", "--enable-nontrapping-float-to-int", "--enable-reference-types", "--enable-sign-ext"]

[lib]
crate-type = ["rlib", "cdylib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../🛍️products/💻️os/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
ui_styling = { path = "../../../🖱️ui/🎨️styling/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-styling" }
infinite_canvas = { path = "../../../../🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/♾️infinite/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-infinite" }
# 🧬️ Proc-macro for `#[derive(ToValue, FromValue)]`, additive alongside serde
# (RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS, 26/09/01). `semio-framework-os-kernel`
# above is already a direct dependency, so the derive's default `::semio_framework_os_kernel` crate
# path resolves without a `#[value(crate = "...")]` override.
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
serde = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true }

# 🌉️ Browser-only `EditorSession` canvas bridge (`🦀️.rs`'s `Wasm` region). Excluded from
# `wasm32-wasip2` because `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the WASI component target too — the
# wasip2 guest never attaches an `HtmlCanvasElement`.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.83"
wasm-bindgen = { workspace = true }
web-sys = { version = "0.3.98", features = ["HtmlCanvasElement"] }

[package]
workspace = "../../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-os-infinite"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "OS infinite family — world/canvas/board Shape V2 glue"
build = "build.rs"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "product"
id = "os-infinite"

[lints]
workspace = true

[features]
typegen = []
# 🌉️ Declared (but never enabled) so `🗺️surface/🏔️terrain/🦀️.rs`'s path-mounted
# `#[cfg(feature = "session-bindgen")]` wasm bridge doesn't trip `unexpected_cfgs` here — this
# crate path-mounts that file without the surface crate's own `session-bindgen` default, by design
# (avoids duplicate `TerrainSession` symbols linking surface+infinite into one cdylib).
session-bindgen = []

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_os_infinite"
crate-type = ["rlib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-ui-locale = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🌐️locale/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-artifact-infinite-dag = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-value-derive" }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
# ⏯️ Decodes the `World3dScene.tool_run_trace` delta for the world's trace layer (`🌍️world/⏯️tool-run-trace`).
# Renderer-side only: ui/ui-scene/os-kernel/job never depend on it (`📓️wave-W0-A.md` cycle rule).
semio-framework-tool-run = { workspace = true }
# 🧱️ `boxed_fixed_slots` (the heap-first fixed slot table every retirement/admission registry in
# this crate builds through) plus the browser session bridges' async vocabulary. Unconditional: the
# helper is target-neutral and `semio-framework-job` already pulls this crate in on every target.
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
semio-framework = { path = "../../../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework" }
math = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🧮️math/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-math" }
geometry = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/📐️geometry/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-geometry" }
graph = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🕸️graph/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-graph" }
ui_styling = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🎨️styling/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-styling" }
semio-framework-ui-viewport = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🪟️viewport/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio_framework_3d = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🧊️3d/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-3d" }
compiler = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/📚️compiler/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-compiler" }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
# 🔤️ First-party RFC 4648 codec — replaces the third-party `base64` crate for `icon_codec`'s
# `data:...;base64,...` decode (target-neutral: guest-reachable via `board_resolve_icon_kind`, see
# `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`). RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01).
base64_codec = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🚪️io/🔤️base64/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-io-base64" }
# #️⃣ Unkeyed BLAKE3 for the `registerBrushMesh` upload identity (`🌍️world/🦀️.rs`) — byte-identical
# to the puzzle guest's own `brush_mesh_digest` and React's `puzzle3dBrushMeshDigest`, which is what
# lets the guest refuse a page run that does not reassemble into the announced mesh.
semio-framework-hash = { workspace = true }
# 🏔️ Required by the path-mounted `🗺️surface/🏔️terrain/🦀️.rs` above, which decodes
# Terrarium RGB-encoded elevation PNGs via the first-party `semio-framework-pixels` codec (no
# third-party runtime dependency) instead of `image`/`png`. That file is compiled into BOTH this
# crate and `semio-framework-surface` (mounted here by `#[path]` because surface depends on
# infinite, so a real dependency edge would be a cycle) — a shared source file needs the same
# dependency declared in every crate that mounts it. This removes `image`/`png`/`flate2`/
# `miniz_oxide`/`fdeflate`/`crc32fast`/`adler2`/`simd-adler32`/`byteorder-lite` from EVERY target's
# graph here, including `wasm32-wasip2` — this was the last unconditional `image` dependency in
# this manifest. RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01).
semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pixels" }

# ⚠️ RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01): a prior attempt to move
# `vello`/`vello_svg`'s `wgpu` feature and `ui_wgpu`'s `wgpu-engine` feature behind a
# `not(target_env = "p2")` target table was REVERTED here because `🌍️world/🦀️.rs` named
# ~26 `ui_wgpu::wgpu` symbols (`Mesh3dFault`, `BoundedActionFault`, …) unconditionally, forcing
# `wgpu-engine` to stay on for every target including wasip2. That root cause is now fixed: those
# symbols were split into the target-neutral `ui_wgpu::draw_types`/`ui_wgpu::gizmo`/`action`/`input`
# tier (see `🖱️ui/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/🦀️.rs`'s top docstring), so `wgpu-engine` — and with it the
# real `wgpu` crate and its `wasm-bindgen-futures`/`js-sys`/`wasm-bindgen` chain — can finally be
# narrowed away from `wasm32-wasip2` here too. `gpu_session` (`🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`, the only
# consumer of `vello::Renderer`/`util::RenderContext`/`vello::wgpu` in this crate) is already
# `#[cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))]`-gated, so no wasip2 capability is
# lost.
#
# 🖊️ A later pass (`🔍️research/📓️vello-scene-first-party.md`) went further: `vello` itself (plus
# its `vello_encoding` buffer format and their font/SVG/codec transitive tail — `skrifa`,
# `read-fonts`, `font-types`, `png`, `guillotiere`, `moxcms`, `pxfm`, `svg_fmt`, `bytemuck`,
# `id-arena`, …) is now ALSO absent from the `wasm32-wasip2` table below — `canvas::Scene` no
# longer needs a real `vello::Scene` to build/measure/dispose commands, only to rasterize one,
# which `wasm32-wasip2` (a WASI Preview 2 guest with no GPU device access) never does. A later
# pass (`🔍️research/📓️kurbo-peniko-first-party.md`) went further still: `Scene`'s guest-reachable
# value types (`Cap`/`Join`/`Stroke`/`Color`/`FillRule`/`BlendMode`/`RasterImage` in
# `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`) are now first-party plain values, not `kurbo`/`peniko` wrappers, so `peniko`
# moved into the host/browser-only target table below, next to `vello`. The geometry follow-up
# reimplemented `Point`/`Vec2`/`Affine`/shapes/`BezPath`, including adaptive circle/arc/rounded-rect
# path generation, so `semio-framework-geometry` now keeps `kurbo` only as a test oracle and no
# longer brings `kurbo` or its transitive tail into `wasm32-wasip2`.
#
# 🔤️ `typst-assets` belongs to the standalone font tool. `typst`/`typst-svg`
# themselves were deleted outright (not narrowed) — grepped zero usage anywhere in this crate's
# source on ANY target, native included; they dragged in `usvg@0.45.1`/`biblatex`/`citationberg`/
# `comemo`/`ciborium`/… (100+ crates) for nothing. `usvg@0.46.0` (via `vello_svg`) is used by
# `🖼️canvas`'s icon/SVG-icon rendering (`svg_icon`/`SvgDocument`) AND by `mod text`'s map-label
# shaper (`append_label`/`label_byte_world_x`) — both traced this session
# (`🔍️research/📓️infinite-text-shaping.md`) as host/browser-only or unreachable on
# `wasm32-wasip2` (paint-tree-only, or behind flow's already-gated `wasm_session` bridge, or in
# `semio-framework-editor`, itself absent from every plugin's wasip2 dependency graph), so
# `vello_svg` moved out of the `wasm32-wasip2` target table entirely below.
[target.'cfg(not(all(target_arch = "wasm32", target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
ui_wgpu = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui", features = ["wgpu", "wgpu-engine"] }
vello = { version = "0.9.0", features = ["wgpu", "wgpu_default"] }
vello_svg = { version = "0.10.0", default-features = true, features = ["wgpu"] }
# 🎨️ Only the host-gated `SceneCommand::replay_into`/`Scene::vello_scene` rasterization boundary
# (`🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`) still names `kurbo::`/`peniko::` directly — every guest-reachable value type
# is first-party now (`Cap`/`Join`/`Stroke`/`Color`/`FillRule`/`BlendMode`/`RasterImage`). Rust only
# exposes a crate's OWN direct dependencies by name, not a transitive dependency's, so this crate
# keeps its own `kurbo` edge to
# write `kurbo::Stroke`/`kurbo::Cap`/`kurbo::Join` at the conversion boundary — narrowing it to
# host-only correctly describes when this crate itself touches `kurbo`. Same exact
# `kurbo@0.13.1`/`peniko@0.6.1` instances `vello` itself resolves to (confirmed via
# `cargo tree -p peniko@0.6.1`/`-p kurbo@0.13.1`), so this is a dependency *edge* onto an
# already-locked package, not a new crate version. RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-
# ARTIFACTS (26/09/01), `🔍️research/📓️kurbo-peniko-first-party.md`.
kurbo = "0.13.1"
peniko = "0.6.1"
# 🖼️ Real pixel decode for `icon_codec::decode_raster_icon_bytes`'s host/browser arm and
# `IconPaintCache::get_or_build`'s icon-painting path — both host-only on `wasm32-wasip2` (see
# `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`'s `raster_icon_bytes_to_rgba` and `➡️directed/🦀️.rs`'s
# `get_or_build` docstrings). RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01).
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg", "webp", "gif"] }

[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", target_env = "p2"))'.dependencies]
ui_wgpu = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🖱️ui/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui", features = ["wgpu"] }
# 🚫️ `vello` (and with it `vello_encoding`/`skrifa`/`read-fonts`/`font-types`/`png`/`flate2`/
# `miniz_oxide`/`fdeflate`/`crc32fast`/`adler2`/`simd-adler32`/`guillotiere`/`moxcms`/`pxfm`/
# `svg_fmt`/`bytemuck`/`bytemuck_derive`/`id-arena`/`static_assertions`/`core_maths`) deliberately
# absent here: `canvas::Scene`'s only unconditional job is to build, measure and incrementally
# dispose first-party `SceneCommand`s (see `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs`) — real rasterization
# (`Scene::vello_scene`, building a real `vello::Scene` by replaying those commands) is reachable
# only from `gpu_session::render_frame`, already `not(all(wasm32, p2))`-gated, i.e. never on this
# target. `peniko`/`kurbo` are consequently ALSO absent from THIS crate's own dependency edges here
# (both moved into the host/browser-only table above): every value type `Scene`'s guest-reachable
# API (`fill`/`stroke`/`draw_image`/`append`/`push_layer`/`pop_layer`/…) needs is now a first-party
# plain value in `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs` (`Cap`/`Join`/`Stroke`/`Color`/`FillRule`/`BlendMode`/
# `RasterImage`), converted to a real `peniko`/`kurbo` value only inside the host-gated
# `replay_into`. The geometry follow-up also removed `kurbo`'s final guest edge, so `kurbo`,
# `arrayvec`, `smallvec`, and `polycool` are absent from plugin `wasm32-wasip2` graphs.
# 🚫️ `vello_svg` (and with it `usvg`/`rustybuzz`(via usvg)/`fontdb`/…) deliberately absent here:
# `svg_icon`/`SvgDocument` (icon *painting*) and `mod text`'s `usvg`-shaped label shaper/painter
# (`append_label`/`append_label_tspans`/`label_byte_world_x`'s native arm) are both gated
# `not(all(wasm32, p2))` in `🖼️canvas/🦀️.rs` — every real caller traced this session is
# host/browser-only or unreachable on this target. `label_byte_world_x`'s `wasm32-wasip2` arm uses
# the character-width heuristic (`label_extent`/`label_advance`/`label_text_inset`) instead; icon
# painting's arm is `IconPaintCache::get_or_build`'s existing `None`. RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-
# ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01), `🔍️research/📓️infinite-text-shaping.md`.
# 📐️ Header/attribute-only dimension reader replacing `image`/`usvg` for this target's two
# dimension-only call sites (`icon_codec::decode_raster_icon_bytes`,
# `svg_icon::svg_icon_content_bounds_from_str`). RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-
# ARTIFACTS (26/09/01), `🔍️research/📓️intrinsic-size-wiring.md`.
semio-framework-intrinsic-size = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/📏️intrinsic-size/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-intrinsic-size" }

# 🌉️ Browser-only session bridges (`gpu_session`/`wasm_session`/`wasm_bridge` in `🖼️canvas` and
# `🎲️board/…/🕸️dag`, plus the `wasm_bindgen_futures` alias their async-fn codegen needs). Excluded
# from `wasm32-wasip2` because `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the WASI component target too —
# the wasip2 guest never attaches an `HtmlCanvasElement`. `dag_debug_log`/`pointer_event_now_ms`
# (same `🕸️dag` file) needed genuine wasip2 arms instead — see their docstrings.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.83"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.106"
web-sys = { version = "0.3.98", features = ["HtmlCanvasElement", "Window", "Request", "RequestInit", "RequestMode", "Response", "console"] }

[build-dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
